source.paper_reference: Yapar et al., Dataset of Pathloss and ToA Radio Maps With Localization Application, arXiv:2212.11777
source.evidence: local gene_data/feko/REPRODUCTION_NOTES_ZH.md and dataset paper Table I
source.evidence_boundary: 2D RadioMapSeer polygons contain footprints only; 25 m is the dataset 2D simulation parameter.

scene.coordinate_convention: polygon and antenna JSON use bottom-origin x,y; image arrays use row=(H-1)-y,col=x
scene.building_height_source: 2D dataset Table I; fixed height applied to polygon footprints
scene.tx_height_audit_note: 2D dataset Tx/Rx are both configured at 1.5 m; no rooftop audit applies

png_gray_mapping.method: linear gray/255 to signed pathgain/pathloss dB

physics_prior.owr_cd_algorithm_name: OWR-CD (One-Way Recursive Corner Diffraction; canonical UTD wedge)
physics_prior.auto_selection_rule: Use OWR-CD when Tx/Rx heights are close and both are below half the maximum building height; otherwise use OWR-RD.
physics_prior.d1_d2_definition: 3D Euclidean distances using fixed 25 m building proxy and 1.5 m Tx/Rx

visualization.note: Fixed across selected scenes/Tx; no per-image min-max normalization.
